gloss: free diving; skin diving; diving without equipment

definitions.gloss: free diving; skin diving; diving without breathing apparatus
definitions.explanation: The practice of diving underwater without scuba gear or other breathing equipment, relying only on holding one's breath.

examples.english: To collect shellfish by free diving.

examples.japanese: {素潜|すもぐ}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{海底|かいてい}→海底：13287_kaitei⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{潜|もぐ}った→潜る：03931_moguru⟧。
examples.english: I dove to the ocean floor by free diving.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海女|あま}→海女：13366_ama⟧さんたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{素潜|すもぐ}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{潜|もぐ}り→潜る：03931_moguru⟧、{鮑|あわび}やサザエ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{採|と}って→採る：20862_toru⟧きた。
examples.english: The ama divers went into the sea by free diving and harvested abalone and turban shells.

notes:
Composed of {素|す} (plain, bare, without accessories) + {潜|もぐ}り (diving). The {素|す} prefix indicates doing something in its simplest, unequipped form — here, diving without any breathing apparatus.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {素潜|すもぐ}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{潜|もぐ}る→潜る：03931_moguru⟧: to dive by free diving
- {素潜|すもぐ}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捕|つか}まえる→捕まえる：01214_tsukamaeru⟧: to catch fish by free diving
- {素潜|すもぐ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{漁|りょう}: fishing by free diving
- {素潜|すもぐ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do free diving

CULTURAL NOTE:
Free diving has a long tradition in Japan, particularly through the ⟦{海女|あま}→海女：13366_ama⟧ (female pearl divers and shellfish gatherers) of regions like Mie Prefecture and Shima Peninsula. These divers have practiced {素潜|すもぐ}り for over 2,000 years.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦スキューバ→スキューバ：23452_sukyuuba⟧⟦ダイビング→ダイビング：05238_daibingu⟧: scuba diving — uses breathing equipment; the opposite approach to {素潜|すもぐ}り
- ⟦シュノーケリング→シュノーケリング：28887_shunookeringu⟧: snorkeling — uses a snorkel at the surface; {素潜|すもぐ}り involves going fully underwater
- ⟦{潜水|せんすい}→潜水：14817_sensui⟧: diving — a general term for going underwater
